anchors.description: Vertical spacing between corresponding chrome pull-handle points of two consecutive drawers on the gray steel filing cabinet front (above the chair back).
anchors.visible_evidence: Two consecutive drawer faces each carry an identical chrome bow pull with a keyhole and a recessed label plate above it; the cabinet runs from its top plate (~y131) to the floor (~y414), consistent with a standard ~52 in four-drawer steel file cabinet whose drawer pitch is about 11-12 in.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand/series and drawer count (2 vs 4) are not identifiable; typical office steel file cabinets have drawer pitches of 0.26-0.35 m, while compact or non-standard units could fall outside this range.

anchors.description: Front width of the white desktop laser printer on the wooden desk at right, between its front-top-left and front-top-right corner points.
anchors.visible_evidence: White boxy unit with a dark output slot on top and a front paper slot, typical of a compact A4 monochrome laser printer (roughly 0.33-0.40 m wide class).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No legible brand or model marking; the chosen endpoints sit a few pixels inside the true front corners, so the span may be slightly shorter than the full body width.
